verdict.rationale: Archived Smithery docs once described platform-run OAuth with zero OAuth configuration, encrypted write-only credential storage, and automatic token refresh that falls back to an auth_required status. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, accounts and API keys stopped working on October 31, 2026, and Smithery now remains only a public, non-proxied MCP registry. No current product delivers OAuth flows, credential vaulting or token refresh, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh
